name: Oth
hail: Lighthouse. We are Oth. We have watched your beam turn for a while now.
Oth, to the Lighthouse. You did not see us. That was by design.
We are Oth. We speak rarely. Now is one of those times.
close: We will go quiet now. Oth.
finding: {part} We checked it against a long record.
{part} It is not new to us.
sighting: {part} Few would have noticed. We did.
{part} We were looking that way, as we usually are.
archive: {part} We share little. This, we share.
{part} Do not ask where the rest is kept.
culture: {part} That is as much as we say of ourselves.
{part} We are not easy to see, and we prefer it.
request: {part} We will know if you are wrong.
verdict: {part} We have watched enough to be sure.
Weighed against all we have seen: {part}
accord: {part} We will watch to see it kept.
{part} Speak of it to no one.
